title: velaris.capabilities/0 (provisional)
description: A ratchet baseline: for each program in a repository, the grants its velaris.audit/1 document says it needs (velaris-spec SPEC.md section 9). PROVISIONAL: the reference implementation, velaris-lang, does not read or write this document yet, and until it does this format may change without the schema name changing. The shipped form will be velaris.capabilities/1. This schema checks shape. SPEC.md section 9 states the rules it cannot: that programs are sorted by file, that grants are sorted and reduced (no grant covered by another in the same entry), that a port is between 1 and 65535, and how paths are normalised before comparison.

file.description: The program's entry file, relative to the directory that holds the baseline, '/'-separated, with no empty, '.' or '..' component.

grants.description: The grants the program's audit says it needs, in the budget grammar of SPEC.md section 4 with the restrictions of section 9.2: no counts, one module per ffi: grant, paths as the program writes them.

note.description: For people. Tools must not read meaning into it.

anyOf.description: One Python module: text up to the first '.', no ',', '@', ':' or whitespace.
One fs direction under a path, written as the program writes it; no ',' or '@'.
A host name, lower case, optionally with a port.
A wildcard: '*.' and at least two labels, optionally with a port.
An IPv6 address in brackets, optionally with a port.
